note: Clearly-labeled SAMPLE derived from editorial seed topics (data/trends.json). Not live data — for consumer development only.

trends.title: "6-7" — Gen Alpha's defining brainrot joke
trends.summary: Born from Skrilla's viral TikTok song "Doot Doot" and LaMelo Ball edits, the phrase "six-seveeeeen" exploded across classrooms worldwide. South Park aired a parody episode on Oct 15. Random, meaningless, inescapable — the signature joke of Gen Alpha internet culture.

trends.title: GTA 6: robberies and partner getaways detailed
trends.summary: Rockstar gave a closer look at how GTA 6 wants players to plan crimes — robberies and partner getaways front and center. Every crumb of GTA 6 news moves the entire gaming internet.

trends.title: "Six Seven" (Seis Sete) funk dance
trends.summary: Brazilian funk track with finger-counting choreography and a shrug on the beat — the dominant dance challenge on TikTok right now, amplified by J-Hope (BTS) to 75M+ views. Crossed every demographic from Japanese high schoolers to WWE creators.

trends.title: Trump roasts rally protester; Nobel Prize outrage
trends.summary: October 11's top US political story: Trump roasting a rally protester on stage plus outrage over the Nobel Prize. Political clip content is the highest-velocity, highest-risk lane — massive views, massive comment wars.

trends.title: Mini-dramas — TikTok's fastest-growing NEW category
trends.summary: Mini dramas are the fastest-growing NEW category on TikTok since the platform began promoting episodic series in June 2026. Serialized micro-dramas with cliffhangers turn viewers into subscribers — the format rewards consistency, not one-off virality. (buytiktokaccount, Oct 2026.)

trends.title: Houthi missile strike on Riyadh airport
trends.summary: A Houthi missile strike on Riyadh's international airport reportedly killed at least 12 and injured hundreds — fears of major Middle East escalation. Breaking-news explainers always spike; maps and timelines win.

trends.title: "Bow Bow Bow" — Zeddy Will's bend-and-bounce
trends.summary: Zeddy Will's "Bow Bow Bow" with a bend-and-bounce move and a shouted "BOW!" hook — spreading from straight dance versions into fit checks and duo dances. At peak: 246K videos on the sound (SocialPilot, Sept 25–Oct 5, 2026).

trends.title: #nba explodes on TikTok (+493%)
trends.summary: Per Revid's tracking, #nba is the fastest-rising hashtag in popular TikTok posts this week — up 493% to 59 posts, with #roblox also climbing at +164%. Preseason storylines + highlight culture = the algorithm's favorite sport right now.

trends.title: Nana Patekar dies at 75 — meme legend tributes
trends.summary: Veteran Indian actor Nana Patekar died Oct 8 in Goa of a suspected cardiac arrest. Beyond three National Film Awards and the Padma Shri, he was the face of a thousand reaction memes — the drink-spit take, Uday Shetty's laugh. The internet is mourning and remixing his most iconic clips.

trends.title: Hurricane Isaias makes landfall
trends.summary: Hurricane Isaias killed at least four and knocked out power for hundreds of thousands after US landfall. Storm content — prep, survival, aftermath — reliably trends every landfall; safety-first framing wins trust.

trends.title: This week's breakout TikTok sounds
trends.summary: Per Revid's sample of 5.4K popular posts: "BLUE WATER CANDY" by DJ Allanzinho JP is #1 steady (13M views on top posts), "Strangers" by SKARS is rising 2.3x, and Lucien Marceau's "Courtly Elegance Boccherini" is cooling. Catch a sound while it's climbing.

trends.title: "Halloween: The Game" storms the Xbox charts
trends.summary: The surprise of October: a Halloween horror game sitting at #6 on Xbox's Top Paid chart, surrounded by sports giants and Minecraft. Seasonal horror + genuine sales = the underdog story of the month.

trends.title: #GrrMondays
trends.summary: A throwaway line from Ted 2 (2015) dug up as the internet's shorthand for Monday. Post whatever your Monday actually looks like, stamp #GrrMondays on the image, done. One of the first clips passed 2.8M views in a fortnight; now redrawn as animations and fake weather forecasts.

trends.title: "Street Fighter" hits theaters Oct 16
trends.summary: The Street Fighter movie lands October 16 — video-game adaptations are officially Hollywood's favorite genre, and every release spawns the same content wave: expectations, lore checks, and opening-weekend verdicts.

trends.title: Cozy-fall jazz beds
trends.summary: Five of the top 10 sounds in Metricool's Oct 1, 2026 chart are jazz/piano/ambient instrumentals — the cozy-fall romanticize-your-routine wave. Plus original beds: "My Day Is Good" (unproductive-day confessions), "Hey Y'all," "After All Seasons Change" (summer-to-fall transitions). (Virlo; Nuelink, Oct 2.)

trends.title: 2XKO drops Sett as surprise champion
trends.summary: Riot's tag fighter gears up for its last content drop with an extra surprise: Sett joins the roster. Fighting-game roster drops always spike lab content, combo videos, and tier debates.

trends.title: AION 2 launches free-to-play
trends.summary: The classic MMORPG returns as a free-to-play launch this week — a massive franchise revival moment. MMO launches are content goldmines: leveling races, first impressions, class guides.

trends.title: October's stacked release calendar
trends.summary: October 2 brought LISA's "Press Play", Miranda Lambert's "Crisco", and Victoria Monét's "Frequency of Love"; Oct 23 brings the Black Parade 20th anniversary. Plus Tom Cruise's Iñárritu film and Verity in theaters. Reaction and ranking season.

trends.title: "And Emily… that's all" audio
trends.summary: Miranda Priestly's ice-cold line riding renewed attention around The Devil Wears Prada 2. Creators pair the audio with unrelated videos — the clip lands at the end where one person gets singled out, ignored, or subtly embarrassed.

trends.title: Dhurandhar 2 enters the Grammy race
trends.summary: Ranveer Singh and Aditya Dhar's Dhurandhar: The Revenge — after a massive box-office run — is seeking Grammy consideration in nine categories. Indian cinema chasing Western awards is a whole content genre unto itself.

trends.title: AI "Fruit Love Island"
trends.summary: Over the summer, an AI-generated parody dating show with fruit contestants went viral — heartbreak and drama, all produce. Named by USA Today as one of 2026's defining viral moments and now a top Halloween costume idea (pineapple/watermelon fits).

trends.title: Mahesh Babu's next director: Vanga vs Lokesh
trends.summary: With SS Rajamouli's "Varanasi" in production, the race is on for Mahesh Babu's NEXT film: Sandeep Reddy Vanga vs Lokesh Kanagaraj reportedly in contention. Director-race speculation drives endless Telugu cinema debate content.

trends.title: "Stop the Wedding" photo carousels
trends.summary: Wedding-regret photo carousels set to Ashe's audio — creators post the wedding pics and let the captions do the talking. A carousel-native format riding the wedding-season long tail. (New Engen, Oct 2026.)

trends.title: "There She Goes" shimmy dance
trends.summary: Cyril Riley & MOONLGHT's "There she goes" soundtracking a shimmy dance — loose shoulders, walking forward, main-character energy. A climbing October sound (SocialBee, Oct 7, 2026), in the same lane as the "Hard Times" relatable-problem memes and slowed "Scott Street" nostalgic edits.

trends.title: AI roleplay comedy
trends.summary: Creators roleplay as AI assistants — deadpan, literal, glitching on slang — for comedy sketches. An emerging-fast container (Lightreel, week ending Oct 3, 2026): the joke is the gap between human mess and machine logic.

trends.title: Ceiling-fan wipe transitions
trends.summary: An emerging-fast transition container: the camera whips past a ceiling fan and the scene changes on the other side. Zero props, pure motion — one of Lightreel's fastest-rising October containers (week ending Oct 3, 2026), alongside AI roleplay comedy and yellow-text relationship reposts.

trends.title: #spookyseason peaks — Halloween is a Saturday
trends.summary: Halloween lands on a Saturday this year, so costume content gets a full weekend to peak. #spookyseason, #octobermood, #halloweencostume, #31daysofhalloween are all peaking or rising. The single biggest seasonal content window of Q4 is WIDE open right now.

trends.title: October calendar memes
trends.summary: The October calendar itself is the meme — circling the 31st, counting down days, treating the month like a loading bar for Halloween. An emerging-fast container (Lightreel, week ending Oct 3, 2026); calendar memes resurface every month with a new twist.

trends.title: Ramalama Costume Walk
trends.summary: Low-angle creepy walk zooming out to reveal a Halloween fit, set to Róisín Murphy's "Ramalama (Bang Bang)". Rising, 430.7K videos on the sound (SocialPilot, Sept 25–Oct 5, 2026; also New Engen). No text, no talking — the walk IS the video.

trends.title: The "Two Fishes" deadpan audio
trends.summary: Creators defending a relatable take over Corbin Mims's Love Island USA audio — deadpan "two fishes" logic applied to your niche's most unreasonable opinion. (New Engen, Oct 2026.)

trends.title: Battlefield 6 hits Game Pass day one
trends.summary: The biggest shooter of the fall lands via EA Play/Game Pass — EA's bid to drive the franchise forward after Battlefield 5's disappointment. Day-one Game Pass means the player flood (and the content flood) starts immediately.

trends.title: Taylor Swift "Patient Zero" wedding edits
trends.summary: Taylor Swift's "Patient Zero" (single out Sept 25) soundtracks wedding edits — plus "leaving something behind" audio for quitting jobs and ending habits. Rising, 149.3K videos on the sound (SocialPilot, Sept 25–Oct 5, 2026; Virlo).

trends.title: MLB playoffs — World Series Oct 23
trends.summary: #mlbplayoffs is peaking on TikTok as the postseason rolls toward an Oct 23 World Series. Sports TikTok is loud all month — watch parties, picks, and one viral play away from a career-making clip.

trends.title: Valor Mortis — the new soulslike to watch
trends.summary: From One More Level (Ghostrunner): a first-person soulslike where you play William, a Napoleonic soldier raised from the dead in plague-gripped Europe. Launches Oct 13 at $39.99, day one on Game Pass. No pre-orders — everyone's going in blind together.

trends.title: Pumpkin Head Illusion
trends.summary: Pumpkin held to the lens becomes a fake head — the body below does the dancing. Set to a groovy spooky remix of the "it's just a bunch of hocus pocus" line. Zero editing, one prop; doubles for fall-decorating content. (New Engen; Virlo, Oct 2026.)

trends.title: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer
trends.summary: Star Wars goes full arcade racer — one of the two biggest launches of the week alongside Gears E-Day. Podracing energy meets the modern Star Wars machine.

trends.title: Gears of War: E-Day launches
trends.summary: The Coalition takes Gears back 14 years before the original — a young Marcus Fenix and Dom facing Emergence Day on Sera, rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5. Launched Oct 6 on Xbox Series X/S and PC with solo, split-screen co-op, and expanded Horde Siege.

trends.title: Trump announces Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire
trends.summary: Trump announced an energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine — but gave few details and neither Moscow nor Kyiv confirmed. Unconfirmed huge claims are prime explainer territory: what's verified vs what's claimed.

trends.title: "Be OK" — happy dance over chaos
trends.summary: Ingrid Michaelson's "I Just Want to Be OK" soundtracks happy-dance-over-chaos: an upbeat track clashing with chaotic captions about real life — inboxes, bills, deadlines. (New Engen, Oct 2026; Later, Oct 2, 2026.)

trends.title: Text From "-A" — the Pretty Little Liars call-out
trends.summary: Pretty Little Liars copy trend: creators call out something they're hiding — bad habits, guilty purchases, secret opinions — as if "-A" is watching and about to expose them. 53.5K videos (MediaNug, 10/1/26; Later, Oct 2, 2026).

trends.title: "Upside Down" before/after transitions
trends.summary: Before/after main-character transitions with hand gestures to an original sound — flip the phone and the scene changes. Emerging-fast containers in the same lane: ceiling-fan wipes, AI roleplay comedy, yellow-text relationship reposts, October calendar memes. (Later, Oct 2, 2026; Lightreel, week ending Oct 3.)
